reviews.body:
✅ LGTM!

I measured this PR at head `c20ddcd` and found no medium or high findings. It delivers everything #648 asks for: the tolerances are converted with `Decimal(str(tol))` in all three comparisons in [`NumericComparator._numbers_equal`](https://github.com/awslabs/stickler/blob/c20ddcdd770d8ceb62ac3d3367d26e1d5fcb212f/src/stickler/comparators/numeric.py#L653-L675), and a boundary test is added.

**Scores on `origin/dev` and on this PR.** Each run printed which source tree it imported.

| Case | dev | PR |
|---|---|---|
| `absolute_tolerance=0.3`, 8.0 vs 8.3 | 0.0 | 1.0 |
| `tolerance=0.3` alias, 8.0 vs 8.3 | 0.0 | 1.0 |
| `relative_tolerance=0.3`, 10 vs 13 | 0.0 | 1.0 |
| `relative_tolerance=0.3`, 0 vs 0.3 (the `num1 == 0` branch) | 0.0 | 1.0 |
| String inputs `"8.0"` vs `"$8.30"`, abs 0.3 | 0.0 | 1.0 |
| `np.float64(0.3)` tolerance, and `np.float32` values | 0.0 | 1.0 |
| abs 0.3, 8.0 vs 8.3000001 (just past the boundary) | 0.0 | 0.0 |

**Other checks, all passed:**
- Negative values, zero tolerance, int, `Decimal`, `inf` and `1e20` tolerances give the same results on both trees. Nothing that matched before fails now.
- End to end through a JSON Schema with `x-aws-stickler-comparator-config` and through `model_from_json`: `overall_score` goes from 0.0 on dev to 1.0 on this PR for the 8.0/8.3 and 10/13 cases.
- No other code reads `absolute_tolerance` or `relative_tolerance`, so no other code path keeps the old boundary.
- Full suite with `--all-extras`: 6772 passed, 3 skipped, 1 xfailed. `ruff check` is clean.
- Mutation tests: I reverted each of the three changed comparisons one at a time, and each revert fails its own case in the new parametrized test.
- The CHANGELOG entry is under `[Unreleased]` → `Fixed` and links #648. The merge-base is the current `dev`.

**Non-blocking (low):**
- A `Fraction(3, 10)` tolerance or `absolute_tolerance=True` now raises `InvalidOperation`, where dev returned 1.0. Neither type matches the `float` annotation, and no loader produces either one.
- Pre-existing, on a line this PR only renamed: when `num1 == 0` and `relative_tolerance > 0`, the code returns before it checks `absolute_tolerance`.

**Note for maintainers:** CI has not run yet. The four fork workflows show `action_required`, so a maintainer must approve them in the Actions tab.
